detailed_descriptions.en: You live a peaceful life alongside your sister Mea, getting by as an independent magic researcher. One day your home is visited by a strange girl, Lirili, who introduces herself as a succubus. You've never met a succubus, let alone any other monster that could talk, but she warns you of a coming monster invasion. Despite being a monster herself, Lirili is adamant that she wants to put a stop to the invasion, and asks for your help destroying the crystals that will facilitate it. You're not sure why, but you find yourself convinced by her story. You set out on the quest with your sister and your new companion beside you. Tactical, turn-based battles Enter battle with party members each suited to their own unique role. Classic archetypes like tank, healer, and striker are all represented here, and you can tweak their abilities by choosing the right equipment. Classic JRPG game loop Strike out into unknown areas and explore, and bring back money and materials to upgrade or replace equipment. A tale that's more than it seems Lirili's tale of a monster invasion is no more than an opening to a story that explores loss, love, and the nature of reality. A memorable cast of characters Your four party members are only the beginning. Meet characters that range from sinister to wacky as you move through the game's story.
